children: Oura is the latest buzzy startup to postpone its previously-announced initial public offering. Earlier this month, Anthropic pushed back its highly-anticipated IPO from October to November, and in recent days Holtec Nuclear and Bamboo Insurance have also delayed their planned IPOs. The moves comes as investors grapple with volatile oil prices and inflationary pressures.(kelly.cloonan@wsj.com)
